summary: Claim: A finitely generated Z_p-module generally has torsion, so X(\tilde{k})_{Gal(\tilde{k}/k)} is isomorphic to Z_p^r \oplus T where T is a finite p-group. If T \neq 0 or r = 0 with T \neq 0, it is not a free Z_p-module and does not have a Z_p-basis; moreover, it has not been proven that X(\tilde{k})_{Gal(\tilde{k}/k)} is torsion-free or free over Z_p, rendering the subsequent basis and matrix r
